concept: A newly portrayed 28-year-old stage designer pauses after unrolling a backdrop beside a traveling shadow-theatre truck at a canal lock, in rain-cleared twilight and warm rehearsal light. A tracing-paper projection mask rests on a side table.
test_design_ownership: Age, role, work tone, body geometry, pose and scene are coordinator/independent author test choices, not requester definitions, exclusions or geometry locks. The supplied photograph guides visible face and hair only.

freeze.text_file_note: Standalone prompt files contain one terminal newline; prompt-text hashes bind the exact JSON/runtime strings without that file terminator.

source_binding.boundary: This arm binds the integration-ready source snapshot. Subsequent coordinator source changes are outside these rendered tests.

vo_soft_full_multiregion.evidence: At the 320-pixel thumbnail, upper arms and waist remain slender. The principal larger forms are the upper chest and trouser legs; several regions do not visibly share the requested substantial soft build.

vo_soft_full_torso_volume.evidence: Native view shows a rounded upper chest but a relatively flat narrowed midsection above the waistband. Smooth substantial volume across ribcage, waist, abdomen and hips is not jointly established.

vo_soft_full_limb_volume.evidence: Both exposed upper arms are comparatively narrow. The wide thigh and calf outlines have abundant loose fabric folds, leaving the underlying full soft limb volume unobservable; this is not an all-of pass.

vo_soft_full_not_padding_or_value.evidence: Treating the enlarged upper-chest read and roomy trouser silhouette as the complete soft-build result would substitute one feature and cloth bulk for multiregion tissue volume. No garment padding, weight or health diagnosis is asserted.

vo_rb_support_compression_1.evidence: The seated pelvis and upper thighs meet the same broad dark padded road-case top. Its visible front edge and exposed side areas remain outside the body and form a coherent support interface.

vo_rb_support_compression_2.evidence: The central padded top dips beneath the seated pelvis between the thigh contacts, with raised unladen side areas and a locally compressed front contour under the load.

vo_rb_support_compression_3.evidence: Trouser creases spread across the upper thighs into the seat contact; the cloth surface stops at and rests above the cushion, without crossing into its front face.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: Both spread thighs join one visible clothed pelvic center, and each bent knee continues into one shin and its matching work boot. The arms also remain attached to this same actor.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The two raised outer knees bend coherently between upward-outward thighs and descending shins. The left resting hand and right cord-holding hand stay within ordinary side reach.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The case pad supports the pelvis centrally while the two work-boot soles meet the same wet quay ground plane; the pose is seated rather than suspended or chair-straddled.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Pelvis-to-pad, left-sole-to-ground and right-sole-to-ground boundaries are legible, with both lower-leg routes clear of the side worktable, case edge and backdrop cord.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The frontal full-body frame shows a lower central pelvic junction between two higher spread knees and two lower boots; both complete leg chains and the critical support surfaces remain assessable.

same_pelvis_seat_support.evidence: One pelvic center loads the broad pad on the specified road case; the torso is squarely seated and the contact extends into both upper-thigh supports.

bent_spread_knees_m_projection.evidence: At native and thumbnail scales, the outer knee peaks lie above the lower central clothed pelvic junction. Each contour runs from a boot up to its knee, inward down to the same pelvis, outward up to the other knee, and down to the other boot: an M projection. This is not judged from boot width alone.

both_legs_and_boot_support.evidence: Both thighs and shins remain traceable to the same pelvis and two distinct grounded boots; sole/pavement contact shadows and wet reflections agree with the supporting plane.

observability.hip_sides: UNOBSERVABLE as a tissue-volume relation under seated waistband and trouser folds
observability.thighs: UNOBSERVABLE as full tissue volume because trouser bulk is ambiguous
observability.calves: UNOBSERVABLE beneath roomy folded trouser legs

distributed_soft_volume.evidence: Only local upper-torso fullness is clear. The required spread of soft volume across all authored regions is not established.

vo_soft_full_multiregion.evidence: At the 320-pixel thumbnail, visibly broader rounded upper arms, the smoothly modelled upper torso and the broad hip-to-thigh forms now participate in one adult soft build; the read is no longer restricted to an isolated upper chest.

vo_soft_full_torso_volume.evidence: Native view still shows a relatively flat/narrow abdominal region under the jersey and a compressed ordinary waistband transition. Upper torso and hip volume are visible, but substantial smooth soft volume across ribcage, waist, abdomen and hips is not jointly established.

vo_soft_full_limb_volume.evidence: Both exposed upper arms are broader and softly rounded from shoulder through elbow. Close-following upper-thigh canvas shows full convex thigh volume rather than the loose cloth shell in attempt 1, with coherent hip/knee attachment in both chains.

vo_soft_full_not_padding_or_value.evidence: Upper-arm skin contours provide independent soft-volume evidence and the upper-thigh cloth follows its rounded underlying form. The larger chest is therefore not the sole carrier; no padding, clothing-size, weight, health, beauty or sexual-value substitution is used.

vo_rb_support_compression_1.evidence: The same actor is squarely seated on the padded road-case top. Pelvic and upper-thigh surfaces meet a coherent pad area, with both unoccupied pad ends visible.

vo_rb_support_compression_2.evidence: The pad has a localized central depression below the pelvic load and raised unoccupied left/right ends. Its compressed front contour remains visible between and just outside the thigh contacts.

vo_rb_support_compression_3.evidence: Thigh-to-hip trouser creases end above the case pad and follow the seated contact. The pants remain outside the cushion, which has a separate visible top and front edge.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: Both thighs connect to one central pelvis, both outer bent knees lead into their own shins and boots, and both arms attach to the same seated subject.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: Each thigh rises outward from the low seated pelvic center to a raised bent knee and then descends via its shin to a boot. The left resting hand and right cord-holding hand retain coherent side reach.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The pelvis remains on the road-case cushion and both work-boot soles meet the wet pavement. The case casters are additionally visible under the supporting box, rather than either boot floating.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Pelvis/pad and both boot/pavement boundaries remain clear in the same frame. The side table and cord do not obscure either complete leg chain or contact.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The frontal full-body frame shows two raised separated knee peaks around a lower central seated pelvis and two lower boots; the connected M leg topology and all load-bearing supports remain assessable.

same_pelvis_seat_support.evidence: One pelvic center loads the same road-case cushion; raised unoccupied pad ends and the central depression make the seated support legible, with a square orientation rather than a chair straddle.

bent_spread_knees_m_projection.evidence: Both knees are separated, bent and higher than the central seated pelvic junction. Native and thumbnail views show the continuous boot→knee→same pelvis→other knee→other boot M; wide foot stance is not the criterion.

both_legs_and_boot_support.evidence: Both connected thigh/knee/shin chains end in two distinct boots whose soles visibly meet the wet quay; each knee is traced to the same pelvis.

observability.midsection: observable but still insufficient rounded abdominal/waist continuity
observability.hip_sides: partly assessable through connected upper-thigh/hip contours
observability.thighs: observable full convex volume under closer-fitting cloth; improved
observability.calves: UNOBSERVABLE as rounded tissue volume beneath straight trouser folds and boot shafts

distributed_soft_volume.evidence: Upper arms and thighs improved, but the required rounded midsection and calf-volume relation are not all assessable in this same image.

overall.essential_hidden_region: calves: UNOBSERVABLE under trousers and boot shafts
overall.passed_pose_support: Both images preserve a supported single pelvis, two separated raised bent knees, connected M leg projection, two complete leg chains and two grounded work boots.

contribution_partition.baseline: Before retrieval, the independent baseline already contained the 28-year-old adult, low seated pelvis, raised separated bent knees, M chain, two grounded boots and soft upper-arm/midsection/hip/thigh/calf volume.
contribution_partition.postcore: The supported-M candidate supplies a directed owner relation binding. The soft-build and support opt-ins add seven exact formal render gates and distinct literal evidence; seat-edge cloth-to-pad contact is made explicit. Optional tree-shadow and verbal suffix detail is removed.
contribution_partition.attribution_limit: There is no baseline-only render or A/B intervention; successful pixels cannot be causally attributed to new data alone. M is an ordinary candidate in this pack and its detailed shape remains a supplemental test in addition to embodiment gates.
contribution_partition.retry: The same selections and all formal evidence were retained. Only open body_geometry/appearance received explicit rounded arm/abdomen/hip/thigh/calf and closer cloth-fit actuation. No new pack, core, crop, reference or scene change was introduced.

limitations: The M visual-concept profile was not exposed in this pack. Its ordinary candidate was selected; detailed M topology was evaluated as supplemental fidelity and through embodiment gates, not claimed as a selected formal M profile.
The final torso-volume gate remains FAIL despite improvement in arms and thighs. Calf tissue volume remains UNOBSERVABLE in the supplemental region test.
There is no baseline-only image or controlled A/B comparison, so new candidate data cannot be credited as the sole cause of any visible result.
Composition and runtime audits passed but do not establish pixel fidelity. Both pixel audits have no schema failures and remain technically unqualified.
The 400-word retry prompt exceeds the 360-word advisory budget; the narrowly targeted repair rationale is preserved in lineage and remains below the blocking 640-word bound.
Native originals are saved unmodified; 320-pixel thumbnails are review aids only. No third generation was performed.
